rationale: The draft's claims about Update 1.9.51 adjusting space combat difficulty (chunk 5510784213098362871-115), granular difficulty sliders (chunk 5766372999940259445-5), the Free Lanes Update adding ship modules including stealth cloaking (chunk 1828894815567715-29), and Update 1.16.236 adding outpost QoL improvements (chunk 1828894815567746-17) are all grounded in the chunks. However, the draft's opening assertion that 'patches haven't touched the core of what you're describing: flight control responsiveness, the depth of ship combat, or the fundamental feel of base and ship building' is not supported by any chunk — no chunk explicitly states that these core systems were not addressed, and the draft uses this unsupported framing to contextualize the subsequent patch claims.
